<!doctype html>
<html lang="en-GB">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=5">
<title>Fast Delivery Campaign V28</title>
<style>
:root{--design-width:1536;--design-height:1024}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#eef3f1;font-family:Arial,sans-serif}
body{min-width:320px}
.page{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:1536px;margin:0 auto;line-height:0;box-shadow:0 18px 60px rgba(7,54,48,.16)}
.master{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.hotspot{position:absolute;z-index:2;display:block;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;line-height:1;text-indent:-9999px;overflow:hidden}
.hotspot:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #d7eb68;outline-offset:3px}
.request-top{left:4.45%;top:34.7%;width:17.9%;height:5.4%}
.watch-top{left:23.25%;top:34.7%;width:15%;height:5.4%}
.video-play{left:24.4%;top:83.6%;width:5.1%;height:7.7%;border-radius:50%}
.request-bottom{left:56.8%;top:91.5%;width:17%;height:5.6%}
@media(max-width:700px){
 body{overflow-x:auto}
 .page{width:980px;max-width:none;margin:0}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main class="page" aria-label="Fast Delivery campaign">
<img class="master" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Fast Delivery campaign showing the five-stage delivery journey, six-step guide, Cockpit experience video and request panel.">
<a class="hotspot request-top" href="#request" aria-label="Request Fast Delivery">Request Fast Delivery</a>
<a class="hotspot watch-top" href="#experience" aria-label="Watch the Fast Delivery experience">Watch the experience</a>
<a class="hotspot video-play" id="experience" href="#experience" aria-label="Play Fast Delivery in Cockpit video">Play video</a>
<a class="hotspot request-bottom" id="request" href="#request" aria-label="Request Fast Delivery">Request Fast Delivery</a>
</main>
</body>
</html>
